text: Given valid credentials and no filters, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then it returns the standard list envelope and each item has id, first_name, last_name, email, role_name, my_glue and last_sign_in_at.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_handlers.py::test_list_account_users_returns_envelope_with_expected_fields -> 1 passed. Asserts the mocked GET /users response (first-name/last-name/email/role-name/my-glue/last-sign-in-at) is flattened into items with id, first_name, last_name, email, role_name, my_glue, last_sign_in_at.

text: Given name, email and role_name are passed, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then they are forwarded as filter[name], filter[email] and filter[role_name] on the GET /users request.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_handlers.py::test_list_account_users_forwards_filters -> 1 passed. Asserts route.calls.last.request.url.params has filter[name]=='Jane Doe', filter[email]=='jane@example.com', filter[role_name]=='Administrator'.

text: Given a sort value such as "-created_at", When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then the sort query parameter is forwarded unchanged to IT Glue (no local validation, matching every other list tool).
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_handlers.py::test_list_account_users_forwards_sort -> 1 passed. Asserts sort param equals '-created_at' unchanged, no server-side validation of the value.

text: Given the account has more users than fit on one page, When the caller walks the result with next_offset, Then every user is returned exactly once and a page IT Glue cuts short continues exactly where it stopped.
notes: Covered by adding ("itglue_list_account_users", "/users", {}) to the shared LISTS table in tests/test_paging_offset.py; actual parametrized ids collected above (position args8 in LISTS at implementation time).
evidence: uv run pytest tests/test_paging_offset.py --collect-only -q | grep itglue_list_account_users -> both ids found; uv run pytest -q tests/test_paging_offset.py -k itglue_list_account_users -> 2 passed. Shared walk() helper confirms all 60 synthetic records returned exactly once across cut pages for both default and page_size=200.

text: Given the X-ITGlue-API-Key header is missing, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "not_configured", ...}} rather than raising.
notes: Covered generically via the shared run() path (asserted today against get_organization); the new tool goes through the same run() helper unmodified, so no per-tool duplicate was added.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_handlers.py::test_missing_credentials_envelope -> 1 passed (generic, exercises the same run() path itglue_list_account_users uses unmodified). Also confirmed directly on the new tool by the live smoke test below: curl POST /mcp with X-ITGlue-API-Key header omitted -> HTTP 401 (CredentialMiddleware rejects before any tool runs, same for every tool including itglue_list_account_users).

text: Given IT Glue returns 429 then 200, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then it retries once honouring Retry-After and returns the successful envelope; given IT Glue returns 403, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false}}.
notes: Error-code mapping and retry/backoff are exercised generically against other tools (get_organization / itglue_health_check) through the shared ITGlueClient.request() path; the new tool reuses that path unmodified, so no per-tool duplicate was added.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_handlers.py::test_error_mapping tests/test_handlers.py::test_retries_rate_limit_then_succeeds -> 7 passed (parametrized 401/403/404/422/500 mapping + 429-then-200 retry), all through the unmodified ITGlueClient.request() path itglue_list_account_users calls via api.page/client.get.

text: Given tools/list is queried, When itglue_list_account_users is registered, Then it is present with readOnlyHint true, has no agent_id parameter, is listed in README's Tools table, and no existing tool loses a name or parameter.
notes: Requires adding an itglue_list_account_users entry to tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json in the same change (done).
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_tools.py -> 5 passed. Live smoke test confirms directly: POST /mcp tools/list over HTTP returns 37 tools (was 36), itglue_list_account_users present with annotations {readOnlyHint: true, destructiveHint: false, idempotentHint: true, openWorldHint: true} and no agent_id in inputSchema.properties. README.md Tools table has a Users row with itglue_list_account_users.
